curated-gf-libre-barcode-39-text-gf-vart: Libre Barcode 39 Text is all slits and stripes, closed up tight. Varta sits beside it with wide-open eyes on its e and a, a friendly sans that lets the heading's oddness stand out, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-licorice-gf-noto-sans-miao: Licorice writes in a relaxed, low-slung hand, its letters snug together (think podcast merch, maybe). Noto Sans Miao stays modern and plain beside it, with small lowercase bodies and an e opened wide, better for brief copy.
curated-gf-licorice-gf-sorts-mill-goudy: Sorts Mill Goudy has tiny lowercase bodies and curves that leave daylight. Licorice, the handwritten heading, tucks its letters in close and closed, so the text serif beneath looks open and bookish by comparison, not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-life-savers-gf-darker-grotesq: Commanding chalk curves greet you here, stopping well short of closing. Darker Grotesque follows in a plain sans with bent-wire strokes and tightly packed stems, so give its size a little extra room to keep that clipped rhythm from crowding.
curated-gf-lily-script-one-gf-maiden-ora: Authoritative is the mood throughout: Lily Script One bends its c nearly shut, while Maiden Orange stands tall and packed like matchsticks in a classic serif. Lily Script One earns its keep big and short.
curated-gf-limelight-gf-noto-sans-malaya: Noto Sans Malayalam reads as friendly and level, with a dominant middle zone. Limelight's bold strokes against hairline-fine ones make the strongest single quality, a loud heading over a plain sans that stays quiet.
curated-gf-lobster-two-gf-coustard: Lobster Two fits its character pairs closely, with crossbars slightly finer than the stems (a true crime podcast cover could wear it). Coustard, the serif body, does the steady bookish work, while the heading handles attitude.
curated-gf-londrina-outline-gf-ojuju: Ojuju brings a sensible thick-thin difference and wide s curves, barely curled in, making it a friendly plain sans for text, even beside a movie night flyer. Londrina Outline handles bold drawn attention.
curated-gf-londrina-shadow-gf-padyakke-e: Tight, flat, and shouty, Londrina Shadow crams its letters with cramped curves. And Padyakke Expanded One answers with a pitcher-wide c in a spread-out serif, so the heading grabs attention while the body lets each glyph breathe.
curated-gf-londrina-sketch-gf-antic: Expressive and crowded, Londrina Sketch packs its characters like nails in a jar. Antic draws every stroke with one nib and leaves its mouths open, so the pair's strongest quality is that jammed-versus-open tension.
curated-gf-londrina-sketch-gf-poly: Poly is bookish serif text with slightly thinning bowls, set under the nails-in-a-jar crowding of Londrina Sketch. And its literary voice reads nicely over a few lines, maybe on a calligraphy practice sheet.
curated-gf-londrina-solid-gf-noto-sans-n: Londrina Solid is bold and tightly clasped, every stroke one weight. Noto Sans New Tai Lue, with cupped round letters, gives the heavy heading room to breathe, and it's happiest on brief copy.
curated-gf-londrina-solid-gf-ruluko: Distinctive Londrina Solid letters could front a surf shop logo. Ruluko, a sans-serif with wide-mouthed counters, stays clean and approachable through brief bursts of reading, far lighter than the heading.
curated-gf-londrina-solid-gf-sanchez: Chunky and snug, Londrina Solid hits like a stamp, while Sanchez keeps a dignified serif voice, maybe on a tabletop rpg handout. Heft meets bookish restraint, best over a few lines.
curated-gf-long-cang-fs-bespoke-slab: Grounded and refined, the serif text stands tall in every lowercase letter (a vintage handwriting journal might suit it). Bespoke Slab anchors brief copy, while Long Cang adds loose, clamped-together handwriting.
curated-gf-long-cang-gf-montserrat-alter: Long Cang clamps its casual letters together like a vise grip. Montserrat Alternates, a contemporary sans whose curves never swell or thin, handles the tidy, everyday work, though only briefly.
curated-gf-love-light-gf-andika: Love Light presses its diagonals thinner than its verticals, gently. Andika, a professional sans-serif with plain unmodulated outlines, grounds that warmth, and it reads best across a few lines.
curated-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto: Noto Sans Sunuwar is clean and approachable, with curves that leave daylight. Love Ya Like A Sister brings the bold, expressive punch with outward-pointing terminals, while the body quietly handles the actual reading.
curated-gf-lugrasimo-gf-oxygen-mono: Lugrasimo has a loose, hand-drawn line that feels friendly. Oxygen Mono, a monospace with fixed-width letters and no pinched curves, lines up neatly beneath it and adds a structured, technical counterpoint.
curated-gf-lumanosimo-gf-playfair: Graceful, casual Lumanosimo draws every stroke with one nib width. Playfair, a traditional serif with thick flanks and hair-thin tops, feels dignified but would tire the eye across long paragraphs.
curated-gf-lumanosimo-gf-wittgenstein: Lumanosimo writes like a quick, friendly hand, every stroke as thick as a drawn wire, perfect for a scrapbook page, say. And Wittgenstein's classic serif body swings between heavy stems and hairline arms, so give it a modest size.
curated-gf-lumanosimo-space-grotesk: Casual pen-and-paper lettering, wire-thick throughout, could headline a band tour t-shirt, say. Space Grotesk's sans body then lays down hollow, breathing counters and ribbon-like lines, which gives the loose handwriting a firm, geometric floor to stand on.
curated-gf-luxurious-script-gf-barlow: Barlow draws its c shapes with the tips pulled well apart. Luxurious Script is best at low, snug, hand-drawn lettering that flows together, while Barlow's sans-serif body is best at staying approachable and constant in stroke.
curated-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-kosugi: Loose, open curves, one steady pen. Kosugi's sans-serif body, with its pliers-jawed c and wire-bent outlines, keeps a longer passage tidy and clean, while LXGW WenKai TC saves the handwriting for the heading.
curated-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-bespoke-seri: Bespoke Serif reads dignified and authoritative, thin strokes about half the weight of thick. Ma Shan Zheng crams its handwritten letters together like teeth, a kids cooking class flyer, for instance, so the serif below gives them a steadier, moderate-contrast footing.
curated-gf-macondo-swash-caps-gf-kotta-o: Macondo Swash Caps lifts its capitals well above the lowercase, with the insides of its c clearly visible. Kotta One answers in a squat text serif, its brushy single-width strokes staying low under tall ascenders.
curated-gf-maname-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads modern and clean, with wide openings on small letters (handy for dyslexia friendly materials). Over a long stretch its big lowercase bodies dominate each line while the ascenders barely show, so Maname's literary serif heading stands taller by comparison.
curated-gf-mansalva-newsreader: Newsreader reads authoritative and refined, its curves opening wide with only a restrained gap between stem and hairline. Mansalva sits beside it in relaxed handwriting whose lowercase shrinks beneath the caps, so the two feel like a handwritten note tucked into a printed page.
curated-gf-manufacturing-consent-gf-enri: Enriqueta reads literary and dignified, its chalk curves stopping well before they close. Over a longer passage that openness keeps the lines light, a sharp turn from the huddled, nearly sealed letters of Manufacturing Consent above.
curated-gf-marck-script-gf-wittgenstein: Personal and graceful, Marck Script is at its best as a tight cluster of felt-tip strokes with no thick and thin at all. Wittgenstein's serif is best at drama in miniature, heavy stems carrying hair-thin arms and big entrances into each curve.
curated-gf-mclaren-author: Expressive and a bit showy, McLaren could headline a tattoo flash sheet. Author follows with a refined serif whose bowls swell slightly, so McLaren grabs attention while Author does the quieter work of being read.
curated-gf-mclaren-gf-poltawski-nowy: Poltawski Nowy is a literary serif, traditional and plain, ideal for a vintage badge emblem, say. McLaren's wide-mouthed c gives the heading some swagger, while the body text underneath keeps its manners and lets the words carry on.
curated-gf-mclaren-gf-xanh-mono: Xanh Mono brings fixed-width, code-style letters with a technical, structured feel. McLaren above it is loose and expressive, so the heading shows off its character while the monospace lines below stay orderly and precise.
curated-gf-mea-culpa-newsreader: Newsreader reads with authority, its curves open and its stem and connecting strokes only slightly different. Mea Culpa is the casual one, round letters with fat sides and hairline tops, while the serif handles the serious sentences.
curated-gf-meddon-gf-noto-serif-sc: Sealed-up counters give Meddon its brush-pressed, personal look, like a note for an art journal. Noto Serif SC follows with rounded, see-through letters, so the heading feels closed and handwritten while the body feels open and literary.
curated-gf-meie-script-gf-bai-jamjuree: Meie Script flickers between black columns and pale slivers, graceful and relaxed. It excels at pen-nib flourish, whereas Bai Jamjuree does its best work as approachable sans-serif text with no thick and thin at all.
curated-gf-meow-script-fs-amulya: Meow Script has pinhole mouths and snug spacing, friendly and handwritten. Amulya below stays modern and generous in its curves, but a long paragraph would feel more like a few notes than a full chapter.
curated-gf-merienda-gf-gilda-display: Merienda has a friendly, hand-drawn feel, fine for a reading journal, say. Gilda Display brings dramatic thick and thin strokes, so give that classic serif a bit more size than you think it needs.
curated-gf-micro-5-charted-gf-manuale: Commanding and tiny-gapped, Micro 5 Charted is all heavy stems and threadlike links. Manuale takes over with large-eyed lowercase and gentle weight shifts, giving a longer passage a traditional, editorial pace.
curated-gf-micro-5-charted-gf-noto-serif: A high-voltage flicker runs across every Micro 5 Charted line, a loud start for a menu special flyer, perhaps. But Noto Serif Georgian stays subdued, so shrinking the heading would blur its gaps while the serif body can take size.
curated-gf-micro-5-gf-kadwa: Pixel-tight and loud, Micro 5 shouts first. Kadwa then takes over with open-ended curves and a generous x-height, built for a quick read rather than long paragraphs.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-artifika: Miltonian hits with curling terminals and woodcut-black weight. Artifika follows with lighter joins and loosely scattered spacing, a traditional serif that stays gentle through a longform essay, though not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-gfs-neohellenic: Distinctive curls and hairline jumps give Miltonian real character, the sort of thing a coffee roaster for outdoorsy types might wear. And GFS Neohellenic, a plain sans with snug spacing and an unpressed pencil stroke, handles a handful of lines without fuss.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-pt-mono: PT Mono reads like typed code, fixed-width and loosely tracked. Miltonian's chiseled stems and scalpel-thin curves bring the drama above it, while the monospace stays orderly underneath and keeps things structured.
curated-gf-miss-fajardose-gf-roboto-seri: Relaxed and friendly, Miss Fajardose writes with bold-and-fine strokes and a barely open e. Roboto Serif is its opposite number, a text serif with wide-open eyes and mild variation, best kept to brief copy.
curated-gf-mogra-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded is warm and tightly spaced, with curves that refuse to close. Mogra, with its dominant x-height and near-closed terminals, feels like a loud neighbor to that softness, while the body stays gentle.
curated-gf-mogra-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Commanding Mogra carries rounded-wire stems and arcs in lockstep. Noto Serif Bengali, a classic serif with softly varied strokes and thinner hairlines, would look lost if the heading were shrunk too far beside it.
curated-gf-moirai-one-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-s: Commanding and distinctive, Moirai One keeps every stroke the same gauge, its c nearly looping shut. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std loosens things with open counters and strokes that vary just enough to feel alive.
curated-gf-moirai-one-gf-copse: Moirai One arrives with forklike gaps and uniform strokes that nearly close its letters. Copse, a serif with daylight through every curve, relaxes the page beneath it, and suits brief copy best.
curated-gf-monomaniac-one-gf-noto-serif-: Noto Serif Hentaigana is a classic serif with open jaws and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, handy for something like a phonics and early reading primer. Monomaniac One's monoline strokes sit opposite.
curated-gf-monsieur-la-doulaise-gf-mina: Monsieur La Doulaise swings between fat pressed stems and hairline lifts, like a nib on a good day (maybe for a screen print poster tee). Mina keeps its plain sans strokes simple and its round letters gently open, which makes the flourish up top feel easy to live with.
curated-gf-monsieur-la-doulaise-gf-uchen: Dramatic brush bellies thinning to fine tips mark the heading, Monsieur La Doulaise. Uchen answers with a serif whose thick-to-thin shifts stay gentle, so the showy writing gets a dignified, refined partner underneath.
curated-gf-montecarlo-gf-radley: Radley leads the way, sturdy and dignified, in a text serif. MonteCarlo adds small, wiry handwriting that suits a label (say, potpourri sachets), while Radley does its best work holding the line with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns.
curated-gf-moul-fs-quicksand: Heavy round forms that barely let light through give Moul its blunt, stretched-out presence on the line. And Quicksand lightens everything below with tall, open bowls and strokes of uniform thickness, easy going for a few paragraphs.
curated-gf-moul-gf-noto-serif-dives-akur: Expressive and dense, Moul fills the line with round, closed forms and a deep midsection. But Noto Serif Dives Akuru does the quieter job, with soft curves and refined, classic letters that you can settle into.
curated-gf-mountains-of-christmas-gf-spe: Spectral SC brings a literary, bookish serif voice with sturdy hairlines and wide-mouthed rounds. Spectral SC gives Mountains of Christmas, with its tightly packed bold letters, a steadier, more spacious companion on the page.
curated-gf-mr-bedfort-gf-hubballi: Loose, leaning penmanship up top, perhaps for a baby book. Hubballi plays the plain sans next to Mr Bedfort's jostling, tall-stroked letters, and that unmodulated outline is the quality that keeps the pair feeling friendly yet tidy.
curated-gf-mr-dafoe-gf-anonymous-pro: Inviting handwriting, packed tight, sits over a typewriter-like monospace. Mr Dafoe's closed, gently modulated letters and Anonymous Pro's open, single-weight forms trade places like warm script scribbled beside a technical printout.
curated-gf-mukta-mahee-gf-marcellus-sc: Modern and brisk, Mukta Mahee fills the line with lowercase that stands tall like capitals. Marcellus SC does the opposite job, with gentle stroke modulation and a stately serif stature suited to quieter, literary lines.
curated-gf-mynerve-gf-cutive-mono: Cutive Mono reads like a typewriter, spaced wide with open, precise curves. Mynerve's friendly, hand-drawn round bowls (a fit for a bandcamp page header) sit nicely over that monospace grid, loose scribble above and ordered rows below.
curated-gf-namdhinggo-gf-courier-prime: Bookish by nature, Namdhinggo lets its capitals tower over tightly packed letters. Namdhinggo is best at gentle thickening and thinning, while Courier Prime, a monospace with lowercase filling most of its height, is best at drafting-pen precision.
curated-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-clash-gro: Graceful and relaxed, Nanum Gothic Coding writes like a casual hand. Its loose, wide-mouthed curves meet Clash Grotesk, a sans drawn with no stroke modulation, and that friction is best enjoyed in brief bursts, not long paragraphs.
curated-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-gf-antic-: Relaxed handwriting up top meets hairline-fine refinement below. Nanum Gothic Coding earns its keep big and short, while Antic Didone swells and thins like a pressed brush, made for brief spells of reading.
curated-gf-neonderthaw-gf-overpass-mono: Personal, cramped, casual scrawl up top. Neonderthaw closes up its round letters while Overpass Mono, a monospace, spaces its fixed-width letters wide and loose, and that tug-of-war suits brief copy.
curated-gf-neucha-gf-almarai: Friendly, tight-knit handwriting leads the way. Neucha traces unfinished broad-nib curves while Almarai, a sans-serif of unvarying line width, steadies them, which does its best work on brief copy.
curated-gf-neucha-gf-trirong: Broad-nib curves left unfinished give Neucha its hand-drawn look. Trirong brings softly varied strokes and flared curve ends, bookish and dignified, though stretching it across long paragraphs would ask too much.
curated-gf-niconne-gf-tuffy: Tuffy draws every stroke like cable bent into shape. Niconne pairs fat verticals and filament-thin connectors against that, so size Tuffy up a notch and let it carry a line or two.
curated-gf-norican-fs-plein: Plein opens a clear channel into each round letter. Plein supplies the reliability, Norican the pinched, graceful flourish with barely a sliver between letters, a combination that holds up across a few lines.
curated-gf-norican-gf-noto-znamenny-musi: Noto Znamenny Musical Notation stops its terminals far from the stem. Norican is best at casual, pinched flourish, while Noto Znamenny Musical Notation handles clean, modern clarity, better with brief copy (a plant shop window, say).
curated-gf-notable-gf-petrona: Notable isolates each glyph in a generous margin of blank. Petrona has shallow terminal curls and a tempered contrast, reading dignified and editorial in brief sittings, never jolting or flat.
curated-gf-nothing-you-could-do-gf-belle: Relaxed handwriting up top, with tight little counters and a low x-height. Belleza sits underneath as a sans with moderate thinning in its rounded strokes, so a handful of lines gets a casual voice and a tidier one.
curated-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew-gf-lexend-g: Bookish and traditional, Noto Rashi Hebrew packs a dense band of tall lowercase with slightly thinner hairlines (handy for hostel branding, say). Lexend Giga, a plain sans with generous tracking, keeps a long read flat and open.
curated-gf-noto-serif-khitan-small-scrip: Julius Sans One spaces its letters out wide, with curves left open at the ends. Beneath Noto Serif Khitan Small Script, a longer stretch of it moves slowly, every line holding its width through each turn.
curated-gf-noto-serif-toto-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads big and open, its stubby ascenders tucked beside a tall x-height. Noto Serif Toto brings bookish authority in its headings, and the pair splits the job: moderate contrast above, steady pressure below.
curated-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi-gf-lexend: Dense, tall middles make Noto Serif Vithkuqi look like a tilted nib at work. It handles dignified headings well, while Lexend Giga, a plain sans, spreads out single-weight text (a science lab report, perhaps).
curated-gf-nova-round-gf-yuji-syuku: Yuji Syuku has dignified, openly spaced serif letters with only a slight weight shift. Under the ribbon-like curves of Nova Round (think trailer text cards), Yuji Syuku keeps long paragraphs steady and comfortable.
curated-gf-nova-slim-gf-antic: Understated stroke variation gives Nova Slim a commanding look without any shouting. Antic, a plain sans built from rod-like strokes, can go a notch bigger than you'd expect (for a preschool welcome sign, say).
curated-gf-nova-square-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC keeps its mouths open and its manner dignified, with a low stance. Nova Square, all glass-tube strokes of constant thickness, makes a bold lead, so give the serif a little extra size.
curated-gf-odibee-sans-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus opens each c like the wide mouth of a pitcher, classic and refined without fuss. Odibee Sans above it is bold and compact, so the serif takes over once text runs on.
curated-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Expressive and wide, Offside lets its curves stay open and keeps a level beat without accents of weight. Noto Sans Tamil feels magnified beside it, with terminals stopping far from the stem.
curated-gf-oldenburg-gf-marko-one: Oldenburg looks like a sign-painter's brush at constant width, every curve left open. Marko One, a classic serif with tall caps and petite lowercase, prefers quick lines (a diner menu, say) to pages of text.
curated-gf-oleo-script-gf-almarai: Oleo Script leaves only a hairline gap between letters, stems heavier than crossbars. Almarai keeps its line width constant and its letters open, so it reads smoothly across a couple of sentences without fuss.
curated-gf-oleo-script-gf-inconsolata: Inconsolata reads like code: fixed-width letters and a wide ring of a c. Oleo Script brings bold, showy stems and hairline gaps above, a loud counterpoint to the structured monospace beneath.
curated-gf-oleo-script-swash-caps-gf-aob: Oleo Script Swash Caps stretches its weight like rubber cord, with tiny lowercase under towering capitals. Aoboshi One, a classic serif drawn with a technical pen's line, is the steadier partner, made for brief reading.
curated-gf-oooh-baby-fs-spline-sans: Oooh Baby crowds its letters together, with ascenders towering over the lowercase. The heading does the loose, friendly hello (a wedding memory book, maybe), while Spline Sans, a sans-serif with open curves, handles brief reading.
curated-gf-oranienbaum-gf-fragment-mono: Oranienbaum lets its hairlines nearly vanish beside dark, heavy stems. It handles drama and thread-thin diagonals, while Fragment Mono, a monospace with a tall waist line, delivers lined-up, ruler-straight precision.
curated-gf-oranienbaum-newsreader: Razor-thin hairlines, heavy stems: pure editorial drama. Give Oranienbaum room to stretch large (say, for a wedding website) and let Newsreader, a serif with restrained contrast, carry the text at a modest size.
curated-gf-oregano-gf-quattrocento-sans: Quattrocento Sans reads crisp and modern, its gaps keeping c distinct from o. Oregano brings a crayon-rough rhythm and crouching lowercase up top, while the sans-serif below holds a few quick sentences in place.
curated-gf-orelega-one-gf-piazzolla: Tall wide lowercase, squat ascenders, a stone-cut heft. Piazzolla, a refined serif with near-capital lowercase, is comfortable in brief spans, while Orelega One handles the big statement (a product launch deck, maybe).
curated-gf-original-surfer-fs-gambetta: Gambetta, a graceful serif, opens each counter wide and tapers gently. Original Surfer's wildly swinging strokes carry the showy headline, then Gambetta's gentler weight shift takes over, though neither wants to run through long paragraphs.
curated-gf-original-surfer-gf-sura: Original Surfer swells and snaps from fat curves to wire-thin ends. Sura, a serif, keeps its own contrast low and its terminals open, so the headline gets all the drama while the text underneath stays dignified.
curated-gf-over-the-rainbow-gf-armata: Over the Rainbow looks like a thin rod bent into letters. Armata, the sans-serif partner, spaces its characters generously and fills the line height, which gives the loose handwriting a sturdy, modern anchor to lean on.
curated-gf-overlock-gf-fira-code: Fira Code, a monospace, leaves clear channels of blank space between its letters. Overlock's chunky, nearly touching rounds sit above it, say, on a stack overflow style Q&A, though the body isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-overlock-sc-gf-heebo: Overlock SC stands out with its broad, open counters and barely any height gap between cases. Heebo is a plain sans with a tall central band, so if the text feels dense, enlarge it a notch.
curated-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall bodies that make its lowercase look bold (say, for personal trainer branding). Oxanium is best at flat, single-weight linework with curves ending in clear daylight, while the sans below does its best work with generous gaps at curve ends.
curated-gf-pangolin-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab, a serif, sits low and dignified, with little step between its lowercase and capitals. And Pangolin's friendly one-nib handwriting, with its unthinned curves and wide c openings, is where the pair gets its charm, best enjoyed in small doses.
curated-gf-paprika-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta, a sans, reads with a big x-height and wide-mouthed curves. Paprika's scattered, capital-like lowercase would suit, say, a travel vlog title, but shrink the heading and its big personality gets lost.
curated-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Paprika scatters its letters apart, and its lowercase fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, a plain sans, answers with a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, which is the pair's real strength.
curated-gf-parisienne-gf-radley: Radley, with open counters and sturdy downstrokes, would look at home on a pottery studio sign. Parisienne's closed, nearly fused letters and oversized capitals are what make the pair memorable, while Radley lets the eye move freely.
curated-gf-passero-one-gf-geist-mono: Expressive and bold, Passero One huddles its letters together with narrow e channels. Geist Mono, a monospace, suits a regex cheat sheet, though enlarging it too much would crowd out the heading's punch.
curated-gf-passero-one-gf-noto-sans-mult: Noto Sans Multani is tall and modern, with a wide-mouthed e. Passero One does the loud work, squeezed letters in cable-thick strokes, while the body font stays lofty and pleasant for a brief sitting.
curated-gf-passion-one-gf-noto-serif-eth: Passion One packs thick, heavy letters shoulder to shoulder, like fence pickets in a row. Noto Serif Ethiopic forms solid word blocks with modest modulation, bookish and happiest over a page or two.
curated-gf-patrick-hand-sc-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, with broad open curves. Patrick Hand SC loosens things up with relaxed pen-drawn letters packed tight, and the slab-serif keeps it all grounded, best kept to a quick read.
curated-gf-pattaya-gf-spline-sans-mono: Tight as rivets in a seam. Pattaya keeps its thin strokes weighty while Spline Sans Mono, a monospace in one unvarying weight, lines up like code, and that steadiness is the pair's draw.
curated-gf-petemoss-gf-antic: Antic draws every line with one nib and open mouths. Petemoss is compressed and handwritten while Antic stays a gentle monotone, a mix that stands out best when brief, maybe on a poster.
curated-gf-petemoss-gf-antic-slab: Graceful Petemoss writes tight and hand-drawn, its spacing clamped like a vise. And Antic Slab, dignified with tube-like round bowls, would start to wear across long paragraphs, best left to a brief stretch.
curated-gf-piedra-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded reads wide and bookish, each letter standing apart. Piedra is the one to hit hard, with pinched curves and bold commanding weight, while the serif side refines things for a quick paragraph.
curated-gf-piedra-gf-roboto-flex: Pinched curves and ruler-drawn strokes give Piedra its bold bite. Roboto Flex handles the approachable, open side, brief text rather than long paragraphs, leaving Piedra the bold, closed-in punch.
curated-gf-pinyon-script-gf-noto-sans-nk: Pinyon Script draws friendly, graceful letters with tight rounds and fat verticals between whisper-thin lines. And Noto Sans NKo opens up beside it, its see-through c giving that flourish room, best on a short line.
curated-gf-pinyon-script-gf-trirong: Whisper-thin hairlines against fat stems define Pinyon Script. Give Trirong, with its softly varied serif strokes, a little more size, say, on a brunch menu, as long paragraphs aren't its home.
curated-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mirza: Mirza sits tightly packed and dignified, with a serif's refinement that tires over many lines. Pixelify Sans, blocky and unwavering in its stroke, could front a kombucha bottle label.
curated-gf-plaster-gf-fira-code: Fira Code reads precise and open, with channels of space between letters. Plaster's widely spaced, chunky forms above it make the monospace feel like a technical whisper, and the lines run smoothly down the page.
curated-gf-playball-fs-sentient: Sentient reads sophisticated and restful, its crossbars slightly finer than its stems. Playball's fat bowls and curling tips give the heading flourish, while the serif body keeps its swings in stroke modest and steady underneath.
curated-gf-playpen-sans-deva-gf-darker-g: Inviting and graceful, Playpen Sans Deva looks pen-drawn and relaxed. Darker Grotesque pulls it forward with clipped, tight stems and open terminals, and its crisp sans lines fit a photo caption.
curated-gf-playpen-sans-thai-gf-kaisei-h: Friendly scrawl, then bookish order: Playpen Sans Thai looks casual enough for a therapy notebook, while Kaisei HarunoUmi adds hairline arms on heavy stems. The serif body feels traditional and slightly dense over a longer stretch.

curated-gf-prosto-one-gf-suez-one: Prosto One strides wide and tall, a fit for a movie night flyer. Big and short is where that tall build earns its keep, while classic serif Suez One adds bookish polish to a couple of lines.
curated-gf-protest-guerrilla-gf-noto-ser: Noto Serif Grantha reads refined, its contrast tempered (say, a calligraphy practice sheet). And Protest Guerrilla, soaring in its x-height, does the shouting best, leaving the classic serif to carry a brief stretch of text.
curated-gf-protest-strike-gf-arbutus: Arbutus presses its lowercase tight to the ascenders, spaced like stepping stones. Protest Strike's pinched curls bring the punch, and Arbutus's modest contrast gives a serif a gentle landing, pleasant for light reading.
curated-gf-pt-serif-caption-gf-lexend-ze: Moderate contrast and short-looking ascenders mark PT Serif Caption. Big and brief is where it earns its keep, with sans-serif Lexend Zetta's widely tracked, ribbon-like strokes beside it.
curated-gf-qahiri-mulish: Tight felt-tip curls up top, Qahiri's closed letters set against Mulish's wide-open apertures and large lowercase below. Both stay monoline, so the shut-versus-open difference does all the talking.
curated-gf-qwitcher-grypen-gf-spectral-s: Small, hand-drawn lowercase with nearly shut terminals defines Qwitcher Grypen. It charms in a line or two, while classic serif Spectral SC, with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths, carries brief reading.
curated-gf-qwitcher-grypen-gf-stix-two-t: Qwitcher Grypen writes small and friendly, its rounded terminals barely parted. It is best as a flourish, while STIX Two Text, a serif with pulled-back terminals and slim thins, handles modest portions of reading comfortably.
curated-gf-racing-sans-one-fs-sentient: Sentient reads sophisticated and pinched, handsome on a boutique shop sign. Racing Sans One's hairline terminals on heavy stems bring the drama, while Sentient's closely related strokes keep it grounded, ideal for brief text.
curated-gf-rakkas-gf-wix-madefor-text: Tight, coiled and loud, Rakkas packs its letters shoulder to shoulder. Wix Madefor Text lets its terminals hang open beneath that crush, a contemporary sans that does best with quick bits of text rather than pages.
curated-gf-raleway-dots-gf-besley: Commanding from the first glyph, Raleway Dots pairs heavy stems with hairline strokes (a retro bowling league shirt, say). And Besley, its crossbars a touch thinner than its stems, keeps a few lines moving with dignified editorial ease.
curated-gf-ramaraja-fs-fira-sans: Authoritative and tightly spaced, Ramaraja sets heavy trunks against whisper-thin branches in every letter. Fira Sans stands taller in the lowercase with stout diagonals, so its size can shrink a notch without losing clarity.
curated-gf-rampart-one-gf-david-libre: Shuttered yet stretched, Rampart One draws horizontals slimmer than its verticals, with the spacing pulled loose as an uncoiled spring. David Libre reads refined and unhurried across a few lines, terminals hanging open.
curated-gf-ramsina-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Spacing as narrow as the gap between sheets of glass defines Ramsina, a dignified, bookish serif with terminals crowding each curve. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lets generous open counters breathe against that tight crowding.
curated-gf-ramsina-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far out from the stroke. Ramsina, the dignified, bookish serif heading, crowds its curves tight, which sets off that modern openness below.
curated-gf-ranchers-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus gives every c the wide mouth of a pitcher. Ranchers, commanding and crammed like beads on a wire, narrows every opening, which leaves the pair better with brief text than long paragraphs.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-della-respira: Handwritten casualness leads here, with Rancho's tightly packed, graceful letters. Della Respira brings a serif's editorial authority, capitals towering over the lowercase, a firm footing for friendly handwriting in quick reads.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-m-plus-1: Rancho writes tightly packed, friendly letters by hand, and M PLUS 1 draws tubular strokes with generous eyes. The body text feels pleasant in quick sips rather than long sittings.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-sometype-mono: Sometype Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters with open-mouthed curves. Rancho's graceful handwriting loosens the look, while longer text stays structured and technical, happiest in short bursts (a rave flyer, maybe).
curated-gf-rancho-gf-varta: Rancho's loose, pen-and-paper handwriting sits low, with lots of empty space above its lowercase. Varta follows in sans with wide-open eyes on every e and a, a taller, steadier partner that gives the pair its footing.
curated-gf-rancho-nunito-sans: Casual and friendly, like a note scribbled quickly. Nunito Sans, a soft sans-serif with open-mouthed curves, sits next to it in a way that feels relaxed, a good fit for, say, a reading chart sticker.
curated-gf-ranga-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: IBM Plex Sans Thai reads modern, with open c shapes. Ranga stacks above it in a dark, tightly knit stripe of unshaded outline (think personal trainer branding), so the display heading hits hard while the body keeps things light and open.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-kdam-thmor-pr: Ravi Prakash is bold and expressive, with curves as thick as its straight stems. Kdam Thmor Pro adds bowls that fill the line, and the two feel like one loud, confident voice, say, on a workwear tag.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-roboto-conden: Roboto Condensed reads tight and wiry, with barely visible gaps inside each word and a lowercase that looks enlarged. Ravi Prakash is closed and heavy up top, while the body's open letters let the page breathe underneath it.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-roboto-mono: Ravi Prakash is closed and chunky, with every curve as thick as a stem. Roboto Mono lets paper show between its letters, and that open, technical body is the pair's strongest quality against the heavy heading.
curated-gf-redacted-gf-saira-semi-conden: Redacted is packed tight, almost no slack between glyphs. It handles the loud, stubby statement, while Saira Semi Condensed supplies a steady, magnified-looking weight for the quieter text, say, in a product launch deck.
curated-gf-redressed-fs-synonym: Tiny lowercase beneath towering capitals gives Redressed its quirky, personal look. It brings bold casual handwriting, while Synonym offers a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve (handy for a reel text overlay).
curated-gf-reggae-one-gf-goudy-booklette: Goudy Bookletter 1911 is dignified and bookish. Reggae One spaces its glyphs far apart with a brushed-watercolor shift in weight, which suits showy lines, while the serif body packs its characters shoulder to shoulder like a graveyard prop sign's quiet lettering.
curated-gf-reggae-one-gf-source-code-pro: Source Code Pro reads like typewriter text, with loosely tracked lowercase and curves that open outward. Reggae One towers above with widely spaced glyphs and soft, watercolor-like shifts in stroke, so the loose display and the precise monospace play off each other.
curated-gf-revalia-gf-savate: Loud, loose and swaggering: Revalia strides across the line. Savate follows in sturdy, open-jawed sans-serif, giving that wide-spaced heading a steady partner with a nearly round o.
curated-gf-ribeye-gf-zalando-sans-semiex: Ribeye keeps its curves almost sealed, with a lingering beat. It excels at distinctive, slow-moving display, while Zalando Sans SemiExpanded, a sans-serif with open-mouthed curves, is better for brief copy.
curated-gf-ribeye-marrow-gf-gowun-dodum: Ribeye Marrow strings out separate characters whose tight curls pinch shut, a loose look that might suit personal trainer branding. Gowun Dodum's smooth, tube-like sans-serif opens everything back up.
curated-gf-risque-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans brings tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, with c openings you can see through, under the showier Risque. Over a longer read, that monoline sans-serif stays easygoing.
curated-gf-road-rage-gf-glegoo: Glegoo, a classic serif, has big counters and wide unclosed curves. Road Rage crowds its bristling letters into one stiff, breath-held shout, say, for a conference lightning talk, while Glegoo is better at refined, editorial text.
curated-gf-rochester-gf-biz-udpmincho: BIZ UDPMincho reads with mild thicks and light-passing exits, never crowded. Rochester's curled terminals and nearly colliding glyphs bring warmth, and the text serif's open letters give that closeness somewhere to rest.
curated-gf-rock-3d-gf-anonymous-pro: Anonymous Pro is a monospace with typewriter widths and visible daylight in every curve. Beside Rock 3D's sealed pockets it reads crisply, a fit even for a devops runbook, and stays comfortable over a longer passage.
curated-gf-rock-3d-gf-sanchez: Sanchez, a classic serif, opens its c like a pair of calipers. Its strongest quality is the way that dignified, bookish openness sits against Rock 3D's sealed pockets and slowed-down gaps.
curated-gf-romanesco-gf-jura: Jura reads with wire-like strokes and s curves that open wide at both ends. Jura looks best at modest sizes, where it gives Romanesco's tightly curled handwriting some breathing space.
curated-gf-romanesco-gf-trocchi: Romanesco writes in casual, tightly curled letters, spaced like thread on a spool. Trocchi, a text serif, has a wide-open ring of a c and gracefully thinning bowls, so a longer stretch reads dignified and unhurried.
curated-gf-romanesco-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC is a modern sans-serif with a visibly gaping c, handy for, say, a sticker pack. And Romanesco adds tightly curled, inviting handwriting on top, and the pair is built for quick bursts of reading.
curated-gf-rowdies-gf-zalando-sans: Rowdies squeezes its a, e and s into tight, distinctive little mouths. Zalando Sans leaves every curve open-ended and approachable, so it is happiest in a line or two, not long paragraphs.
curated-gf-ruthie-clash-grotesk: Relaxed and personal, Ruthie writes like quick ink on a page. Clash Grotesk has no modulation at all, so it stays clean and approachable beside that inked softness, made for brief bits of reading.
curated-gf-ruthie-crimson-pro: Crimson Pro brings refined, close-packed serif lines to follow Ruthie, as in a pregnancy journal. Crimson Pro reads with a quiet cadence line after line, though it favors brief bits of text over endless ones.
curated-gf-sail-gf-andada-pro: Sail hits hard, thick stems dwarfing the hairlines around them. Andada Pro is the traditional, bookish serif below, moderately modulated with inviting counters, good for a few quick lines.
curated-gf-sail-gf-cactus-classical-seri: Sail hits like a woodcut, black stems beside pale threads. Cactus Classical Serif carries authority in a wide-open e and gentle weight shifts, though it is made for brief visits, not extended reading.
curated-gf-sail-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpa: Sail jams thick stems against hairline strokes in a tight, hugging fit, all closed-up letters built to shout. Sail grabs the eye; Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens its curves for brief reading.
curated-gf-saira-stencil-one-gf-abyssini: Saira Stencil One swells heavy and round, then thins to a hairline. The standout is weight: that nib-like swell against the brushed-watercolor calm of Abyssinica SIL, a literary serif, pleasant in modest amounts.
curated-gf-salsa-fs-hind: Hind keeps its strokes steady as a drawn string, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals and c ends that never turn inward. Salsa takes the spotlight; Hind runs steadily but is better kept brief.
curated-gf-salsa-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Distinctive Salsa has stubby ascender stems rising from tall-bodied lowercase. Noto Serif Tibetan has restful, modest weight shifts, so give it extra size for, say, an investor pitch deck, and skip long paragraphs.
curated-gf-sancreek-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri rises tall in the lowercase, its rounded letters left unclosed. Sancreek's tight, pinched curls against that openness make the sharpest difference here, and the pair stays pleasant while the text stays brief.
curated-gf-sancreek-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reaches high with a squared-off x-height and a c that opens like a bent paperclip, dignified and editorial. Sancreek brings the drama; Suwannaphum holds up a brief stretch of text.
curated-gf-sancreek-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono is a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side. Victor Mono turns wearing once paragraphs run long, its signage-plain lines stacking up with little give.
curated-gf-sansita-swashed-fs-hind: Big, commanding top line, then a string-straight body. Sansita Swashed carries small letters nearly as tall as capitals, and Hind echoes that height in strokes that stay straightforward, which suits quick reads.
curated-gf-sansita-swashed-gf-mitr: Sansita Swashed lets its small letters stand almost as tall as capitals. It commands up top, while Mitr, a sans with barely any gap between x-height and cap height, keeps bite-sized text approachable (cycling team kit, say).
curated-gf-sarina-gf-yuji-boku: Yuji Boku reads like drawn cable, each stroke holding one thickness and its c pulled wide. And Sarina, with its big gaps and soft ebb of weight, keeps the pairing best with brief lines.
curated-gf-sassy-frass-gf-ibm-plex-mono: IBM Plex Mono spaces its typewriter-like letters generously, with a wide slot between the ends of the c. Sassy Frass scrawls; the mono keeps quick reads tidy (a marching band banner).
curated-gf-sassy-frass-gf-zalando-sans-s: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded wears open-mouthed curves, plain sans through and through, and might turn up on milestone cards. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded does the tidy reading, though not across long paragraphs, leaving Sassy Frass the cramped, casual handwriting.
curated-gf-schoolbell-gf-podkova: Hand-drawn and a bit squeezed, Schoolbell opens its e instead of closing it. And Podkova, a bookish serif, carries the traditional reading while Schoolbell stays casual, best with brief text.
curated-gf-seaweed-script-gf-prociono: Seaweed Script never lets its thin strokes turn spindly, keeping round forms tucked in (an open mic night poster). And Prociono's long ascenders and spilling counters open up what the heading closes, good for a few lines.
curated-gf-seaweed-script-gf-solway: Chunky, muffled and tightly packed. Solway, a classic serif, sits beside it with flatter, stencil-like strokes and a generous eye in the e, so the low heading and the taller body make a lively mismatch.
curated-gf-seaweed-script-gf-zen-kaku-go: Seaweed Script is snug and a bit muffled, with mellow strokes. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, a sans-serif, looks thin yet has no thinner parts, so a long run of it feels smooth, with each bend easy to follow.
curated-gf-sedgwick-ave-display-gf-commi: Commissioner reads smooth and unclogged, every stroke a thin rope. Against Sedgwick Ave Display, whose handwritten strokes ebb and flow like a barely pressed brush, that stiff outline makes the loose, friendly heading stand out.
curated-gf-sedgwick-ave-display-gf-tai-h: Loose, handwritten and friendly. Tai Heritage Pro, a classic serif with dignified, editorial manners, opens its round letters wide, and if the heading shrinks, say for a hair accessories brand, that contrast between closed and open still holds.
curated-gf-sekuya-gf-manuale: Wide, tall and shut tight, ready for a conference lightning talk. Manuale, a text serif, adds large-eyed lowercase and moderate contrast, and that traditional steadiness is what grounds Sekuya's commanding swagger.
curated-gf-send-flowers-gf-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans Devanagari moves in loose, modern curves that never knot at the ends. Send Flowers is the relaxed pen-drawn voice, perhaps for a streamer merch tag, while the sans does the tidy, contemporary work beneath it.
curated-gf-send-flowers-gf-koho: KoHo reads wide open and clean, with a moderate lowercase height. Send Flowers is its tube-like, handwritten opposite, a small-looking lowercase with long upright strokes, and that gap in height and feel is the pair's best trait.
curated-gf-sevillana-gf-monda: Tall l and k tower over rounder letters. Monda, a sans-serif, keeps every small counter unclogged, so if Sevillana were made small, its hairline curves would still sit comfortably above that clear, approachable text.
curated-gf-sevillana-gf-prociono: Prociono reads refined and authoritative, with long ascenders and small lowercase bodies. And Sevillana, say for a rainbow unicorn party, brings a bold, distinctive swell, so the serif feels quiet and spill-open beside it.
curated-gf-shadows-into-light-two-gf-pla: Shadows Into Light Two has curves that open outward, like quick pen strokes. Playfair, a classic serif, adds a dignified pale thread between its black stems, giving the casual handwriting a formal partner on the page.
curated-gf-share-tech-gf-bona-nova-sc: Blunt marker strokes meet gentle modulation: Share Tech over Bona Nova SC, handy for a phonics and early reading page. Share Tech excels at punchy lines; Bona Nova SC at fine, open text.
curated-gf-shizuru-gf-amarna: Shizuru drops its lowercase midline low, with tightly knit, fixed-nib strokes. Amarna's uniform strokes stay clear at modest sizes, better for brief copy (say, for a roller derby team).
curated-gf-shizuru-gf-anonymous-pro: A fixed nib and a low midline give Shizuru its tight, stubborn look. Anonymous Pro's typewriter-width monospace letters and open curves temper that density, making a tidy counterpoint best kept to brief stretches.
curated-gf-shizuru-gf-datatype: Distinctive Shizuru, nib-drawn, low-midlined and tightly knit, sits over Datatype's structured monospace, which is pleasant in moderation. The standout is the mismatch: quirky display above, strict typewriter order below.
curated-gf-shojumaru-gf-mukta: Shojumaru fills the line with clamshell bowls and a big x-height. Mukta's tall-bodied small letters keep text clean and quick, though it's built more for brief reading than endless pages.
curated-gf-shojumaru-gf-nova-mono: Closed clamshell bowls against open mono letters: Shojumaru shouts, maybe on a conference lanyard badge for devs. And Nova Mono, with its drafting-pen line and generous c, stays crisp but wearies over lengthy paragraphs.
curated-gf-short-stack-roboto-slab: Short Stack has a friendly handwritten look, ends cut like one ribbon, fine for a general purpose layout. Roboto Slab sits beside it structured and precise, giving that looseness something firm to lean on.
curated-gf-sigmar-gf-noto-serif-malayala: Noto Serif Malayalam brings bookish refinement and big open counters beneath Sigmar's commanding display, say, for an old movie theater marquee. Noto Serif Malayalam's gracefully thinning bowls glide along, though they're meant for brief reading, not endless paragraphs.
curated-gf-sigmar-one-gf-courier-prime: Sigmar One swings between stout stems and delicate hairline strokes. The heading excels at loud, widely spaced display lines, while Courier Prime handles brief, tidy copy in a steady drafting-pen line.
curated-gf-sigmar-one-gf-esteban: Swelling downstrokes and thread-thin upstrokes: that's Sigmar One all over. Sigmar One makes the loud entrance, while Esteban, a serif with oversized lowercase and a generous e, handles quieter brief copy.
curated-gf-sigmar-one-gf-noto-serif-khoj: Sigmar One swells fat and rivet-stout, then thins to wires. Noto Serif Khojki, a classic serif, answers with soft thick-thin shifts and big bowls, so the pair holds loud and literary side by side.
curated-gf-sigmar-one-manrope: Manrope keeps its curves open and its line a single wire-like width, a plain sans through and through. And Sigmar One, all swollen strokes and near-invisible joins, gives a medieval tavern menu the muscle it would want.
curated-gf-simonetta-gf-share-tech-mono: Bold at the top, a barbershop emblem of a heading, quietly shaded. Share Tech Mono sits below as a monospace, every letter cut from one gauge of tubing, so Simonetta gets to do all the talking.
curated-gf-sirin-stencil-gf-fira-mono: Sirin Stencil punches out big glass-bead counters in strokes with no shift in thickness (a bootcamp landing page could wear it). Fira Mono, a monospace with spaced-out glyphs and a ring-like c, makes it feel measured and structured.
curated-gf-sirivennela-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display glows like neon tubing, each glyph sitting in generous space, ideal for a conference lanyard badge for devs. Major Mono Display stays open and sweeping against the crowded, slot-mouthed Sirivennela, so a long passage would feel precise and technical.
curated-gf-sixtyfour-fs-erode: Stitched, typewriter-tight, and deliberately blocky. Sixtyfour's low-contrast monospace letters meet Erode, a text serif with a tall middle band and gentle ebb of weight, and that dignified editorial warmth is what lifts the pairing.
curated-gf-sixtyfour-gf-aref-ruqaa: Precise, with its gaps like wide stitches in coarse thread, Sixtyfour sets a structured monospace tone up top. Aref Ruqaa answers with welcoming, softly shaded bowls.
curated-gf-skranji-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Noto Rashi Hebrew has a bookish serif hand, lightly engraved like brass lettering. Skranji's barely rising capitals sit against its soft curves and tall lowercase bodies, one commanding and flat, the other gentle and traditional.
curated-gf-slackside-one-gf-new-tegomin: New Tegomin reads with a dignified, traditional air, its c a wide-open ring. Give it a little more size than Slackside One, whose friendly hand-drawn lowercase stays small.
curated-gf-smokum-gf-ledger: Squeezed, inky, and a bit theatrical. Ledger, a classic serif with stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive, carries a long passage with dignified, bookish ease beside Smokum's thread-thin diagonals.
curated-gf-smooch-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans lifts its brush-like stroke ends away before curves close, while Smooch stays closed and casual. Pleasant for a quick skim rather than a marathon sit-down.
curated-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height. Snowburst One cuts bold stencil bridges up top, while the body's ajar a and uniform s carry on quietly below.
curated-gf-snowburst-one-rubik: Expressive stencil letters from Snowburst One could front a toy brand logo. Rubik takes over below with soft, round letters, its lowercase looking big beside capitals and clear at small sizes.
curated-gf-sofadi-one-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet. Sofadi One, with its chalk-arc openings, earns its place big and short, just a few words at most.
curated-gf-sofadi-one-gf-noto-sans-tifin: Chalk-arc openings left unjoined give Sofadi One its commanding, slightly unfinished look. And Noto Sans Tifinagh adds puffed, rounded, inviting bowls, friendly enough for a hiring now sign.
curated-gf-sofadi-one-gf-syncopate: Syncopate spaces its letters like rungs on a rope ladder. Sofadi One's curves lighten toward their ends, while a full block of Syncopate reads like a ruled, technical-pen line, every bowl and stem at the same weight.
curated-gf-sofia-fs-literata: Bookish and sophisticated, Literata draws curves with wide, unclosed mouths. Literata holds sturdy hairlines and gentle weight shifts, while Sofia loosens into friendly, hand-drawn letters bent like tubing.
curated-gf-sofia-sans-extra-condensed-fs: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed packs a tight, high-waisted lowercase. Karma, a text serif whose x-height nearly meets its capitals, has a gentle modulation; give it a bit more size.
curated-gf-sofia-sans-extra-condensed-gf: Ovo reads classic and authoritative, its thins only a hair lighter than its thicks. Sofia Sans Extra Condensed crowds its letters, drawn as if with one nib, while Ovo's spacious curve endings let the page loosen.
curated-gf-spicy-rice-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is clean and approachable, with ascenders that look short because the body is so tall. But shrink Spicy Rice and its wide, tall bowls lose their punch, so it likes a few words.
curated-gf-spirax-gf-alegreya-sc: Alegreya SC has a wide s that never tightens. Spirax up top is lopsided, with heavy stems making its hairlines look tiny, while the body's thick-thin shift stays faint and manageable over a good stretch of text.
curated-gf-splash-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-: Splash huddles its handwritten glyphs into a dense, closed-up scrawl. IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped is the opposite, with curves that refuse to close, and that open-versus-closed tension is the best thing about the pairing.
curated-gf-splash-gf-line-seed-jp: LINE Seed JP reads friendly and level, with horizontals as heavy as verticals. Over a longer stretch its counters keep letting the eye slip in and out, a sharp contrast to the closed, pen-drawn huddle of Splash.
curated-gf-square-peg-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and a bit formal, its modulation visible mainly up close, and its openings stay generous at every weight. Square Peg, low and hand-drawn, makes a loose partner (say, for a hair accessories brand).
curated-gf-srisakdi-gf-belgrano: Blunt, clipped, almost carved. Srisakdi does hairline-free display work with little room between stems, while Belgrano is the one with open-mouthed curves that stay clear and a low, traditional feel.
curated-gf-srisakdi-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with wide channels leading into each counter. Srisakdi's clipped, hairline-free display letters sit moderate in height against that taller body, and that mismatch is the pairing's best quality.
curated-gf-stalemate-gf-electrolize: Lanky handwriting meets machined edges. Stalemate's capitals tower over its low lowercase, and Electrolize, with its open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, brings a modern, tidy counterweight that could suit children's museum signs.
curated-gf-stalinist-one-gf-noto-serif-b: Bold tall rounded lowercase and loose, rope-slack tracking mark Stalinist One as a loud, distinctive heading. Noto Serif Balinese settles in with a comfortable midpoint between flat and dramatic strokes, its lowercase standing tall enough to carry a longer passage.
curated-gf-stalinist-one-gf-noto-serif-o: Distinctive in every tall, rounded, loosely tracked letter, Stalinist One leads, with Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq following in a dignified, sizable lowercase (perhaps for a climbing gym). Shrink that heading, though, and its personality drains away.
curated-gf-stardos-stencil-gf-metrophobi: Stencil-bold stems sit beside fine scribed hairlines in Stardos Stencil, a loud heading that could front phone case art. Metrophobic follows with a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, easy going on the eye.
curated-gf-stardos-stencil-gf-signika: Signika reads plain and modern, with hardly any stroke variation. Stardos Stencil's heavy shoulders thin to a hairline, fine for a little league banner, and Signika carries a brief run of text without fuss.
curated-gf-style-script-gf-mina: Mina reads with plain strokes, fine for a jewelry brand card. Style Script handles the casual, gently swelling handwriting, while Mina handles quick reading in uniform strokes and open curves.
curated-gf-style-script-gf-overpass-mono: Overpass Mono spaces its fixed-width letters loosely and uniformly, while Style Script's handwriting swells gently on each curve. Extended paragraphs would feel rigid and spaced out; brief copy suits it better.
curated-gf-supermercado-one-gf-bree-seri: Bree Serif brings outsized lowercase and a literary feel, while Supermercado One's thick pencil-lead letters speak commandingly. Long paragraphs would drag, though a graveyard prop sign might be right.
curated-gf-supermercado-one-gf-cousine: Chunky meets technical: Supermercado One's pencil-lead lowercase leads, while tall, fixed-width Cousine follows like code, fine for an engineering blog. The heading announces, the monospace body annotates, and long paragraphs would wear thin.
curated-gf-suranna-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands in uniform lines, curves matching its stems. Suranna's stems swell and fade to hairlines up top, and extended text beneath runs in tight, pin-straight rows.
curated-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-hoover: Hoover's compressed ascenders and open e give it a sturdy look. The handwriting of Swanky and Moo Moo, drawn with one nib, is the standout, relaxed and made for a quick glance.
curated-gf-syne-tactile-gf-liter: Liter reads like following a single thread, tall and uniform. Syne Tactile does the lively broad-nibbed flair, with curves that never quite close, while Liter does quiet, wide-mouthed clarity.
curated-gf-tagesschrift-gf-crete-round: Dignified and classic, the text serif is good for brief copy (a dungeon master screen, say). Crete Round stays plain beneath Tagesschrift's bold, flat-weight outlines, giving the page one loud voice and one quiet one.
curated-gf-tangerine-gf-average: Average opens wide on the e, with reed-pen thickening. Tangerine's low, hand-drawn letters and long stems lean lighter beside it, and the pairing favors brief lines over extended paragraphs.
curated-gf-tangerine-gf-jost: Tangerine's low, hand-drawn curves lean back and relax. Jost carries a longer read in broad-gapped sans letters with a uniform stroke, steady and unfussy, though it's happiest when the copy stays brief.
curated-gf-tangerine-gf-red-hat-mono: Red Hat Mono sets every letter in a fixed-width box. Over a longer passage, its ballpoint-pen stroke and slow, measured beats feel precise and technical, which is why Tangerine's loose handwriting above it matters, since the monospace isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-tangerine-plus-jakarta-sans: Relaxed and inviting, Tangerine writes in low, loose strokes. Plus Jakarta Sans sits beside it taller and more precise, a monoline sans-serif that makes the handwriting feel even looser, say on a road trip scrapbook.
curated-gf-the-girl-next-door-roboto-sla: Big, hooked letters with barely any ascender room mark The Girl Next Door, drawn in one unshaded stroke. Roboto Slab follows with structured slab-serif lines and open throats, and that exactness is the pair's strongest quality.
curated-gf-the-nautigal-gf-almarai: Graceful and inviting, The Nautigal looks like neon tubing bent into snug, casual letters. Almarai sits below in a sans-serif with a never-swelling line and open curves, a plainer neighbor that suits brief copy best.
curated-gf-tilt-prism-gf-maiden-orange: Maiden Orange packs tall serif letters tightly, like matchsticks in a box, with traditional authority. Tilt Prism pushes back, its glyphs drawn with one tip and strangely bold, so the two feel like a stern elder beside a showman.
curated-gf-tiro-bangla-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai reads in solid, approachable blocks, with generous openings where its curves meet the stem. And Tiro Bangla's serif strokes, swinging between fat and slender, give the page a dignified, classic voice above it.
curated-gf-trade-winds-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bold, swaggering display letters with moderate contrast. BIZ UDPMincho follows in a refined serif with mild thicks and wide exits, so Trade Winds does the shouting while the body stays measured and suits brief copy.
curated-gf-train-one-gf-lilex: Expressive and wirelike, Train One drifts along in unshaded strokes with a slow, drawn-out cadence. Lilex answers in fixed-width monospace with loose tracking, and a longer passage would feel precise, technical and deliberately spaced out.
curated-gf-triodion-gf-oxygen: Commanding and broad-shouldered, Triodion could front a brand guidelines deck without blinking, its open counters carrying real weight. Oxygen's sans-serif lowercase runs nearly as tall as its capitals, and a longer passage reads clean and contemporary.
curated-gf-trochut-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Ink-bar stems and hairline arcs, maybe for personal trainer branding. Trochut earns its keep big and short, while Chiron Hei HK, modern and with an open bracelet-like c, handles a brief note.
curated-gf-trochut-gf-moderustic: Trochut pairs a heavy diagonal with a hairline one. Trochut does the shouting, even on a tattoo flash sheet, while Moderustic with unfinished broad-nib curves handles a quick note quietly.
curated-gf-tulpen-one-gf-antic: Tulpen One looks bent from a single length of wire. It crowds its strands shoulder to shoulder for impact, whereas Antic, drawn with one nib and open-mouthed, is better with a quick bit of text.
curated-gf-twinkle-star-gf-pathway-extre: Twinkle Star's curves open outward instead of curling in. That handwritten looseness is its job, while Pathway Extreme, sans-serif with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, copes with a short message.
curated-gf-twinkle-star-gf-playfair-disp: Graceful Twinkle Star writes tight, casual letters whose curves open outward (a woodworking shop sign, maybe), staying relaxed throughout. Playfair Display SC adds fat bowls and hairline links, made for quick reading.
curated-gf-uncial-antiqua-gf-ar-one-sans: Uncial Antiqua tracks generously, its lines glittering dark and light. AR One Sans, sans-serif with lifted brush ends, stands taller in the lowercase and carries a brief bit of text without fuss.
curated-gf-uncial-antiqua-gf-im-fell-eng: A big gap between lowercase and capital tops gives Uncial Antiqua its drama, fine for a witchy shop logo. IM Fell English SC reads bookish and open-throated, though it is not built for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-underdog-gf-enriqueta: Underdog draws every stroke like cable, fit for a cigar and bourbon bar. Enriqueta brings literary dignity, its chalky curves stopping short of closing, so paragraphs would unfold like a novel.
curated-gf-unifrakturcook-gf-el-messiri: A packed, level line with no weight accents makes UnifrakturCook a loud start for a birthday slideshow. El Messiri gives its thinnest curves real weight, a modern foil to the uniform strokes, though not for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-unifrakturcook-gf-im-fell-eng: UnifrakturCook weighs its diagonals like its verticals, packed tight (a graveyard prop sign, maybe). IM Fell English SC, a text serif, shifts weight modestly within each stroke, bookish and made for quick reading.
curated-gf-unifrakturcook-gf-noto-sans-m: Noto Sans Manichaean reads modern and tidy, with open-mouthed crossbars. UnifrakturCook sits above it like bent glass tubing, dense and commanding, and the body is best kept to a handful of lines.
curated-gf-viaoda-libre-gf-iosevka-charo: Viaoda Libre hits hard with its thick and hairline diagonals, wound tight like a spring. Iosevka Charon is a monospace that stays structured and rounded, and the two make the strongest case for contrast, say on a commit graph visuals page.
curated-gf-vibes-gf-cossette-texte: Neon-bold and huddled tight. Cossette Texte follows in a plain sans with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, giving the loud heading a clean place to rest (a block party flyer would be one home).
curated-gf-vibes-gf-fauna-one: Dignified and literary, Fauna One carries a tall middle band and shallow ascenders under a heading of glowing neon-tube letters. Vibes brings the shout, and the text serif brings the hush, perhaps for a true crime podcast cover.
curated-gf-vibes-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, high-waisted in its lowercase. Under Vibes, with its ballpoint-plain line, a longer stretch of the classic serif feels settled, a fit for a boot maker.
curated-gf-vujahday-script-gf-mingzat: Hand-drawn and graceful, with a short lowercase. Mingzat has curvy, unclamped letters that feel contemporary, so it can take a modest bump in size while the script stays put for a handful of lines.
curated-gf-vujahday-script-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads plain and open, its letter openings wide as a door left ajar. Vujahday Script adds a friendly hand-drawn swing above it, and the two sit together easily for a handful of lines.
curated-gf-vujahday-script-gf-share-tech: Share Tech Mono reads like typewriter text, precise and technical, every stroke cut from one gauge of tubing. Over a longer stretch it keeps a steady, mechanical rhythm, a sharp foil to Vujahday Script's mellow swing (metal album cover, anyone?).
curated-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-fs-be: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter, and sits under the friendly, nested lettering of Waiting for the Sunrise. Over a longer passage the classic serif feels sturdy.
curated-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-azeret-mon: Walter Turncoat has tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. Azeret Mono underneath is a precise monospace with open letter mouths, and its generous spacing means the size can stay modest.
curated-gf-walter-turncoat-gf-major-mono: Spaced-out monospace letters glow like neon tubing, each set apart by wide sidebearings. Major Mono Display handles the precise, technical side while Walter Turncoat, bendy as copper pipe, stays relaxed and handwritten, handy for a song lyric sheet.
curated-gf-warnes-gf-do-hyeon: Expressive Warnes lets its ink strokes taper off before they touch. Do Hyeon sits beneath in tightly packed sans letters with big, open counters, so the loud top line has a clean partner.
curated-gf-water-brush-fs-chillax: Closed rings up top, loose unfinished loops below. Water Brush earns its keep large and short, a low-slung brush hand, while Chillax, loose as spaghetti, is happier with a quick line than a page.
curated-gf-whisper-gf-biz-udgothic: Whisper looks small and friendly, hand-drawn with long extenders. BIZ UDGothic opens a wide channel into every bowl, so a modest size keeps it pleasant in bite-sized helpings, say, a name poster for a child.
curated-gf-winky-rough-gf-faustina: Winky Rough sets its lowercase almost as tall as its capitals. Faustina, a text serif whose bowls thin gently, lends that clean sans-serif top line an authoritative partner, as in, say, a non disclosure agreement.
curated-gf-workbench-gf-libre-caslon-tex: Structured Workbench sets typewriter-style letters with terminals tucked in tight. Libre Caslon Text adds refined, editorial strokes that shift just enough to be noticed, though it is happier in snippets than full pages.
curated-gf-yeon-sung-gf-biz-udgothic: Yeon Sung hits hard, its crowded, thread-thick curves built to command. BIZ UDGothic keeps a modern, wide-channeled sans-serif underneath, good for a line or two, such as a personal trainer branding.
curated-gf-yeon-sung-gf-google-sans-code: Yeon Sung packs thread-thick curves tightly into a bold, crowded rhythm. Google Sans Code does the opposite job, a monospace with no stroke modulation and a measured beat, best for brief, precise reading.
curated-gf-yeon-sung-gf-kosugi: Kosugi reads wire-bent and clean, with jaws open like pliers. Yeon Sung can go big and bold up top, while Kosugi wants a modest size and a brief line, not pages of it.
curated-gf-yeon-sung-gf-martel: Yeon Sung holds its curves to a thread-like thickness, with no pinched joins or swelling bowls, in a crowded, bold rhythm. Martel's soft stroke shifts let a few paragraphs go down easily.
curated-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-gf-abha: Abhaya Libre reads dignified, its curves wide open. Yuji Hentaigana Akari's loose handwriting against that pressed-nib text serif gives a warm, personal pairing that stays pleasant across a brief paragraph.
curated-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-work-: Work Sans reads crisp and modern, fine for letters to future self. Yuji Hentaigana Akebono brings casual handwritten warmth, while Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and its lines tidy.
curated-gf-zen-antique-soft-gf-anek-mala: Literary from the first glance, with sturdy ink slabs up top. Zen Antique Soft handles weighty authority with its thick stems and paper-thin strokes, while Anek Malayalam handles quiet, plain sans clarity.
curated-gf-zen-loop-gf-source-code-pro: Source Code Pro lays down precise, typewriter-width letters beneath Zen Loop's huddled, expressive display forms. Source Code Pro keeps a mechanical rhythm down the page, pleasant across a few sentences and tiring beyond.
curated-gf-zen-old-mincho-gf-lusitana: Lusitana has soft brush-pressed shifts and breathing counters, giving its text serif lowercase a ribbon-cut look. Zen Old Mincho adds hairline-sharp, high-fashion bite, ideal for a quick page.
curated-gf-zen-old-mincho-gf-roboto: Fat sides, hairline tops: a sharp, high-fashion, editorial look. Zen Old Mincho supplies the drama while Roboto, with generous mouths on its round letters, quietly does the reading work.
curated-gf-zen-old-mincho-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads approachable, with an open-mouthed e and compact lines. Down a full page, Sarpanch settles into an easy plain sans rhythm while Zen Old Mincho keeps its dark-and-light drama.
curated-gf-zeyada-gf-yuji-boku: Yuji Boku draws each stroke like cable, wide-open and dignified. Zeyada's soaring ascenders and casual hand make a loose-meets-formal pairing, lovely for a quick note.
curated-gf-zhi-mang-xing-gf-m-plus-1-cod: Marker-tip swagger over code-style order. Zhi Mang Xing is best at quick, traced-line personality, while M PLUS 1 Code is best at tidy monospace text, made for brief reading.
curated-gf-zhi-mang-xing-gf-savate: Zhi Mang Xing runs its neon-tube strokes in one casual line. Savate's tall rounded o and gentle pen-like weight shifts give the sans-serif body its own lively character, better for a note than a chapter.
curated-gf-zilla-slab-highlight-gf-bryga: Tight and iron-stemmed, Zilla Slab Highlight hits like an iron gate. Brygada 1918 reads in mild, inky swells with wide ring-shaped rounds, dignified enough for a long stretch (an island getaway guide, maybe).
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-aldrich: Aldrich keeps its x-height nearly level with the capitals. Over a long stretch its rounded letters feel cupped rather than clenched, like tracing one thick thread, while JetBrains Mono headings stay loose.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-alumni-sans-co: Alumni Sans Collegiate One reads tall and tightly packed, built for brief stretches. Its curves nearly lock shut, while JetBrains Mono leaves its terminals apart like open scissor blades, and that gap is the pair's charm.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-alumni-sans-pi: JetBrains Mono strings its fixed-width letters loosely, never feeling tight. Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs a dense word texture with oversized lowercase beside small capitals, so running text feels compact (say, a data scientist resume).
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-anaheim: Anaheim gathers rounded glyphs into a dense huddle, lowercase filling the line like capitals, under JetBrains Mono. Longer text glides past the eye without snagging (say, stickers for laptops).
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall, its x-height reaching high like a squared-off woodblock letter, with terminals stopping far from the stem. Long text moves briskly beneath JetBrains Mono headings.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-braah-one: JetBrains Mono draws a plain, unshaded line, handy for cli help output. Braah One, a sans-serif with hugging s curves and a deep lowercase midsection, gives running text more body.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-candal: Clean and generously letterspaced, Candal has curves that close up. JetBrains Mono brings flat, contrast-free letters with terminals held apart, against curves in Candal whose thinnest points still carry real weight.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-hind-vadodara: Loose, fixed-width code letters meet rounded, open-faced text. Hind Vadodara keeps its thickness constant in every direction, leaving spacious gaps in rounded glyphs, beneath JetBrains Mono's loosely strung letters.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-kedebideri: JetBrains Mono draws every stroke with no contrast at all. That gives it a precise, fixed-width code feel, while Kedebideri lifts a skyward x-height line with rounded, inviting letters.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-league-gothic: JetBrains Mono spaces its code-style characters out loosely, terminals flaring apart. League Gothic, a plain sans, packs in tight with a tall lowercase, and that crowded-against-loose tension is the pair's real pull.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-lexend: Lexend has outsized lowercase and open curves, a friendly body that could even carry a scrum master resume. JetBrains Mono above it keeps the fixed-width, code-flavored look going.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-mada: Monoline strokes, fixed-width and unfussy, give the heading its code-terminal look. Mada's sans-serif lowercase towers and its curves stay open, so a modest heading size against a slightly larger body would let that tall middle breathe.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-momo-trust-dis: JetBrains Mono holds its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, typewriter-regular. Momo Trust Display, a plain sans, counters that with drifting, spaced-out letters and a generous x-height, which it handles better than the mono does.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-mozilla-headli: JetBrains Mono looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, fixed-width and loosely strung for an ats friendly resume if wanted. And Mozilla Headline, a plain sans, brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so the two feel like a terminal beside a friendly sign.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-nobile: Thin, looped tubing-like strokes mark this heading as pure monospace. Nobile's low step from x-height to caps and its open letter mouths keep the text quiet, a good fit for a remote engineer resume, so a heading only slightly larger than the body feels right.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-arab: Noto Sans Arabic reads wide and open, with a pronounced x-height. JetBrains Mono, steady in pressure from first letter to last, gives a code-minded heading (say, for a sysadmin resume) that sits well against that spacious sans-serif body.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-copt: Contemporary and clean, this pair leans on texture (a machine learning researcher cv would fit). Noto Sans Coptic fills the line with its dominant middle zone and uncrowded s and c, while JetBrains Mono keeps one steady outline thickness.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-kann: Fixed-width, stress-free curves, all terminal swagger. JetBrains Mono is best at crisp code-style headings, while Noto Sans Kannada, a plain sans, is best at easing gently from small letters to capitals with s curves open at both ends.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-myan: Noto Sans Myanmar reads dense through the middle, with a broad c, a fit for a technical writer resume. But JetBrains Mono's bent-pipe-cleaner texture keeps paragraphs feeling lighter than that heavy strip suggests.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-sinh: Fixed-width letters with terminals that flare apart like open scissor blades define JetBrains Mono. Noto Sans Sinhala counters with a dense, dark stripe of lowercase, where the heading is the one with the code-style spacing.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-sunu: Noto Sans Sunuwar reads friendly, with curves that leave daylight inside them. JetBrains Mono adds a code-style, fixed-width stiffness on top, so give the body the larger size and let the heading stay modest.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-syri: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Syriac has bowls like blown glass bulbs. JetBrains Mono draws every stroke without hairlines or swelling, a stricter, more mechanical job, while the body takes the softer, rounder work of carrying text.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-tagb: Noto Sans Tagbanwa reads clean, its open curves leaving clear gaps. Its lowercase fills most of the line height, which keeps paragraphs steady beneath JetBrains Mono headings (handy on a CI pipeline dashboard, say).
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-ugar: JetBrains Mono draws a ruler-straight, constant-width line, with loosely strung characters that never feel tight. Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps x-height close to cap height and leaves its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, ideal for a resume with projects.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-pragati-narrow: Those fixed-width, code-style letters with terminals splayed like scissor blades are what set JetBrains Mono apart, even in a devops runbook. Pragati Narrow packs a soaring x-height tightly instead.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-preahvihear: Contemporary and a bit technical, JetBrains Mono suits a status bar and tabs. Preahvihear has a lofty x-height and open letter mouths, so a tiny heading will feel dwarfed by large body text.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-radio-canada-b: Radio Canada Big reads neutral and sturdy, its x-height filling the line and its terminals finishing clear of the stem, much like a technical writer resume. JetBrains Mono brings code-style rigidity; the body brings flow.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-savate: Wire-straight and mechanical, JetBrains Mono holds every stroke constant across loosely spaced, fixed-width characters. Savate's mild taper and open curves soften the page just enough.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-secular-one: JetBrains Mono's fixed-width, code-style letters keep terminals splayed apart. Secular One fills the line with a big midsection and unmodulated strokes, so the heading does precision while the body does mass.
curated-jolly-lodger-gf-secular-one: Jolly Lodger is theatrical, its s nearly clamped shut. Secular One, with its heavy midsection and zero stroke variation, wears thin over long paragraphs, so give it, say, a pun greeting card.
curated-kaushan-script-gf-ruda: Kaushan Script writes in a relaxed, calligraphic hand with tightly packed letters. Ruda has a wiry monoline stroke and a sizable x-height that reads cleanly on screen, yet long paragraphs would drag, so picture a perfume sample card.
curated-libre-caslon-display-pt-serif: PT Serif reads traditional and authoritative, with modestly tapering joins. Give Libre Caslon Display plenty of size, since its sharp thick-thin contrast and squeezed letter pairs suit a couple of lines.
curated-lobster-gf-red-hat-text: Lobster is inviting and casual, with a calligraphic hand. Red Hat Text opens up where Lobster crowds in, its curvy technical-pen letters staying loose against the script's tight spacing, which favors quick lines over paragraphs.
curated-luckiest-guy-gf-anuphan: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy pours out heavy single-width ink. Anuphan's big round bowls and clear gaps soften the shouting, a quiet counterpart to Luckiest Guy (say, for a mascot character logo).
